outcome_evidence: The oven door is initially upright and closed (frame 0, left_ego_image). The robot approaches the upper door handle, then pulls the door outward and downward (frames 90–150, image and left_ego_image). The door continues rotating open, exposing the oven interior, and remains lowered at the end (frames 200 and 307, left_ego_image, corroborated by image). No failed acquisition, unwanted object displacement, or damaging contact is visibly established.
